Flow.description:
2/25/26 - [RFS23-11881] Updated language. 9/4/25 - [RFS23-10955] Update API version. Add missing visibility controls on some sections that aren't needed for Residential addresses. 4/16/25 - [RFS23-9021] Swap out Datafetcher for a Screen Action subflow to get the Ship To phone number. 4/2/25 [RFS23-8936] Fix a bug when submitting without certain fields being populated. 3/17/25 - [RFS23-8713] Added new variable and formula to handle editing a shipping address when a new address gets created automatically. This prevents a loop that causes a duplicate record. 3/13/25 - Add additional criteria to get Shipping Addresses element. 2/18/25 - [RFS23/7834/RFS23-7837] Fix bug with order allocation name 2/10/25 - [RFS23-7833] Remove "PO#" from the shipping label preview on all review screens. 1/31/25 - [RFS23-7832] Update shipping label preview layout. 1/16/25 - Fix VAT not showing. 1/7/25 - [RFS23-7947] Update layout of review screens.
12/30/24 - [RFS23-7832, RFS23-7833] Update review screen to show preview of shipping label formatting.
12/30/24 - Add additional configuration to allow internal Amplify users to run the flow.
12/26/24 - [RFS23-7833] Add shipping label preview to review screen.
12/10/24 - Consolidated multiple screens into a single details screen. Visibility and formulas are now used to handle showing certain data to customers.
11/18/24 - Remove Delivery Logistics functionality and move all fields to single Delivery Details screen. Updated Shipping Address data table to use pagination.
10/24/24 - [RFS23-7332, RFS23-7333] Add missing Complete Later navigation to allocation name screen. Fix logic on Complete Later path when the allocation had previously been saved to remove the Completed Date and Completed By name.
10/16/24 - [RFS23-7316] Add necessary variable to keep the "View Shipment Details" button in the right state when reviewing details before saving.
8/12/24 - [RFS23-6460] Add visibility controls on Delivery Services screen. Fix logic in visibility.
7/30/24 - [RFS23-5439] Remove requirement for Shipping Contact to have Ship To in their Contact Type and update flow logic for this change. Updated logic to only show contacts with a phone number. Updated related language.
6/14/24 - [RFS23-5920] Remove Ground Level Delivery question from modal.
4/30/24 - Update Get User Details and Get Account Contacts to handle new logic for affiliated contacts. Logic updated and reviewed. {RFS23-5463]
2/20/14 - Fix residential details confirmation. Add ability for user to update Order Allocation Display Name. 2/14/24 Hid double footer on Delivery Contact Screen 2/7/24 - View only path for prior submitted allocations; 2/6/24 - Improved handling of Continue Later to save previous screens and then show submitted data when returning. Added an Edit path to a confirmed Order Allocation when OA is not Submitted.
1/31/24 - Fix issue with Ship To and Backup Ship To details not showing. Updated Residential Review details. Added Get Records for the ship to contacts.
1/25/24 - Update Confirmation logic to check for a Confirmed date. Changed the final OA Confirmed assignment to set the status to In Progress.
[RFS-23-3471] Update details for the Order Allocation.

fields.name: header
fields.fieldText:
Shipping details

Select the shipping contact and address and provide special delivery instructions below.

validationRule.errorMessage: Allocation site name is too long. Maximum length is 70 characters, including spaces.

fields.name: shipping_address_header
fields.fieldText:
Select a shipping address (required)

Choose where to deliver this allocation site from your shipping addresses below. 


If the shipping address is not listed, return to the Shipping Addresses tab to add a new address then return to Manage Orders to continue.

value.stringValue: Label__c:180, Shipping_Address_Concatenated__c:190, Delivery_Location_Type__c:205, High_Loading_Dock__c:185, Pallet_Jack__c:130, Ground_Level_Delivery_Reception__c:275, Can_Entryway_Receive_Pallets__c:250, Flights_of_Stairs__c:185, Elevator_to_Move_Pallets__c:220, Lift_Gate_Required__c:190, VAT_Foreign_Tax_ID__c:130, Days_of_Operation_Text__c:185, Hours_of_Operation__c:200

fields.name: delivery_contact_header
fields.fieldText:
Select a delivery contact (required) 

All deliveries require a signature. Select the contact below that will be available to sign for this delivery. 


If the contact is not listed, return to the Contacts tab to add a new Ship To contact, then return to Manage Orders to continue.

value.stringValue: Phone (Include country code if outside North America.)

fields.name: Delivery_Instructions
fields.fieldText:
Special Delivery Instructions


If applicable, provide additional instructions needed for this delivery below, or click continue to skip.

fields.name: delivery_Dates
fields.fieldText:
Delay delivery 

To delay delivery, enter your "do not deliver before" date below.

fields.name: earliest_Delivery_Date
fields.helpText:
Date requirements:

  • Date is not equal to today's date
  • Date is in the future

validationRule.errorMessage:
Date requirements:

  • Date is not equal to today's date
  • Date is in the future

fields.name: blackout_Dates
fields.fieldText:
Dates you cannot accept delivery

Enter up to 7 consecutive unavailable dates. US holidays are automatically excluded.

fields.name: Blackout_Window_Start_Date
fields.helpText:
Date requirements:

  • Date is not equal to today's date
  • Date is in the future
  • Date does not equal to or earlier than the ‘do not deliver before’ date

validationRule.errorMessage:
Date requirements:

  • Date is not equal to today's date
  • Date is in the future
  • Date does not equal to or earlier than the ‘do not deliver before’ date
validationRule.formulaExpression: IF( AND( ISBLANK({!earliest_Delivery_Date}), {!Blackout_Window_Start_Date} > TODAY() ), TRUE, AND( {!Blackout_Window_Start_Date} > {!earliest_Delivery_Date}, NOT(ISBLANK({!Blackout_Window_End_Date})), {!Blackout_Window_Start_Date} > TODAY(), NOT({!Blackout_Window_End_Date} < TODAY()) ) )

fields.name: Blackout_Window_End_Date
fields.helpText:
Date requirements:

  • Date is not equal to today's date
  • Date is in the future
  • Date does not equal to or earlier than the ‘do not deliver before’ date
  • Date is not more than 7 days after Blackout Window Start Date

validationRule.errorMessage:
Date requirements:

  • Date is not equal to today's date
  • Date is in the future
  • Date does not equal to or earlier than the ‘do not deliver before’ date
  • Date is not more than 7 days after Blackout Window Start Date

fields.name: txt_Fiscal_Year_End
fields.fieldText:
Proof of delivery within fiscal year 

If this delivery is a requirement of your funding source for this fiscal year, provide the end date of your current fiscal year.

validationRule.errorMessage: The date must be in the future.

fields.name: txt_Room_of_Choice_Delivery
fields.fieldText:
Room of choice

Your delivery service includes delivery to a room of your choice within your delivery location. Please specify the delivery room here.

fields.name: txt_Room_of_Choice_Floors

Delivery floor
